Chidi Ferreira
chidi.ferreira@example.com | Louisville, KY
Chidi Ferreira has 14 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Grayline Cloud (2025-2026), where
they designed internal GraphQL standards used by 10+ downstream services.
Before that, Staff Backend Engineer at Quartzline Technologies (2024-2025).
Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Driftwood Analytics (2020-2024). Before
that, Backend Engineer at Nimbus Cloud (2012-2020). Education: B.S. Software
Engineering, University of Michigan, 2012. Core skills: AWS, Terraform,
TypeScript, Python, Microservices, REST API design, PostgreSQL, MySQL,
Distributed systems, Kafka, GraphQL.
